eras.story: You arrive with nothing. The valley is quiet, and the deep below it has not noticed you.

The Forge Tyrant falls and the deep answers. The strata crack: copper and tin glint on the cave floors. The hounds run in larger packs, and the Tyrant's whelps burn where they die. Something has begun to gather at the edge of your claim.

The Ash Warden falls and the wastes spill. Ember-iron glows in the rifts, silver shows in the high crags, and steel can be worked. The shriekers call further, the wastes' packs run with wisps, and elites walk the outer rings.

design_purpose: Eras are the campaign (docs/systems/progression-eras.md, D-019): the world changes state on milestones the player chose to hit, never on time or a level, and mobs scale per era, never per player. The current era is the last one in this list whose trigger_world_effect is active (an empty trigger is the start); scanning stops at the first unmet trigger, so eras are ordered. Each era changes three things at once - what mobs DO (mob_mechanics: per enemy id, a mechanic name with its numbers; a bare number means {value}), what the ground OFFERS (worldgen.json node types carry an era and surface when it arrives), and what can be WORKED (materials and shapes gated by traits in construction.json, recipes in crafting.json). Numbers here are deliberately mechanics with modest values: hounds +1 to a pack, a whelp's death leaves 3 life per round of fire for 5 seconds in a 1.4 m patch; the felt jump at an era is the world's, not the sheet's. elite_chance_bonus adds to every pack's chance of crowning an elite when it spawns; pack_escorts adds the listed enemies to any pack carrying the key (the wastes run with wisps in era three). The mingling (Wave 8 slice 3; the owner, 4 Sep 2026: on the turn the whole world is affected - mobs transform, gain powers, or 'mobs from different biomes now come mingle across biomes, causing new interactions'): mingle lists, per biome, the foreign families that may join a pack spawning there from this era on, mingle_chance the chance a pack takes one (the sim's pick, deterministic per den), and patrols_cross_biomes sends the night's patrols to the nearest den of another biome instead of toward the spawn. The verbs transform too, as mob_mechanics: the deep's husks guard wider (guard_arc_bonus) and its wisps light two (kindle_two); the tide's lurkers hold longer (root_bonus_seconds) and its knights ward harder (ward_bonus). armour_reduction_cap (Wave 7 slice 2; the owner, 4 Sep 2026: unkillable too early) is the era's ceiling on how much of a hit armour may take away - a quarter in the valley however much iron you wear, nearly half once the deep wakes, most of it in the ash tide - so early gear buys control and life, never a wall, and the wall arrives when the world has already stepped up to meet it.
